exercises.q: I assumed that she was there.
exercises.why: **предположил** — предположи́ть (perfective): to assume, to suppose; to presume, to imply. Wiktionary: пред- + положи́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: I don't have all the facts.
exercises.why: **располагаю** — располага́ть (imperfective): to dispose, to have available; to place, to dispose, to arrange, to set; to gain, to win over; to dispose, to be favourable, to be conducive. Wiktionary: рас- + по- + -лага́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to place, to dispose, to arrange, to set
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: расположи́ть — to place, to dispose, to arrange, to set; предположе́ние — assumption; положи́тельный — positive, affirmative; предположи́ть — to assume, to suppose.
